reviews.text:
Thank you for your continued support.
I really appreciate your courteous service.

When I called because my newly adopted cat had bloody stools, the receptionist asked if it was just her period. Cats don't have periods. I think that someone who isn't a veterinarian or nurse and lacks basic knowledge shouldn't be giving advice. I was lucky because I had just adopted the cat and knew about this, but otherwise it could have been a big problem.

I think the doctor's diagnosis and thorough explanation were very good, but I was surprised and displeased with her attitude when she put one foot on the chair she was sitting in while explaining. Also, the male receptionist's phone manner …

Thank you for taking care of my hamster.

My hamster's condition suddenly worsened, and I rushed him to the clinic, but …
They examine the dog immediately and are very kind. My dog ​​hates injections, but...
The teachers are all kind and their explanations are easy to understand, but there's one person at the reception desk who's unpleasant. …

Despite having excellent doctors, the reception staff's poor quality is quite noticeable. They flatter those who seem like they could bring in money, and treat everyone else with condescension. Where do you think your salaries come from? My family is also unwell and we go to your hospital for treatment.
